text: {"headline":"Infusion Pump Procurement: Scoring Timeline and Payment Records Review","overview":"This brief summarizes documented records concerning the infusion pump replacement procurement, including bid closure, scoring instructions and final award, alongside reporter allegations regarding the scoring process and related payments.","key_points":["Bids for the infusion pump replacement closed on 17 Feb 2026, with the scoring committee scheduled to meet on 3 March to finalise weights and scores [C001, C002].","PERSON_1 instructed PERSON_5 to update the technical score for ORG_2 from 61 to 78 before the sheet went to PERSON_4, which PERSON_5 communicated to others as PERSON_1 wanting 61 -> 78 [C003, C005].","PERSON_1 stated the committee had already agreed verbally so there was no need to recirculate the score sheet [C004].","At the time of the request to raise ORG_2's score, the scoring committee had not yet met, with PERSON_1 also reported as saying if the score was not bumped the pumps would slip another quarter [C007, C006].","A meeting was held on 10 March 2026 attended by PERSON_1 as chair, PERSON_5 and PERSON_6, which recorded final technical scores as ORG_2 78 and ORG_4 74 and recommended award of the infusion pump contract (est. value $1.2M) to ORG_2 [C008, C009, C010].","The meeting record notes no conflicts of interest were declared, and PERSON_4 as Chief Financial Officer approved the award on 14 March 2026 [C011, C012].","Two payments of $18,500 to ORG_3 for consulting retainer - procurement advisory on 2026-03-20 and 2026-04-20 were approved by PERSON_1 [C013, C017].","Reporter alleges being told in early March by a colleague that PERSON_1 had asked for ORG_2's technical score to be raised before the committee met [C014].","Reporter alleges observing two $18,500 payments to ORG_3 for consulting after the contract was signed and finding no consulting agreement, and states a belief that ORG_3 is connected to PERSON_1's husband PERSON_3 but acknowledges having no documents to show this [C015, C016]."],"risk_notes":["Timing gap between documented instruction to raise score and committee meeting raises process documentation questions.","Recorded statement of verbal agreement without recirculation contrasts with record that committee had not yet met at time of instruction.","Payments to ORG_3 approved by same individual involved in scoring instruction, with reporter allegation of missing consulting agreement and unverified connection claim."],"limitations":["No independent documentary evidence was provided to verify the alleged verbal agreement or the reason for the score change beyond the quoted statements.","No documents were provided to establish a connection between ORG_3 and PERSON_3; the reporter explicitly states no documents show this.","No consulting agreement was located in the supplied evidence, but absence of evidence is not evidence of absence and no independent proof of payment purpose was provided.","Evidence does not show intent, authorization basis for payments, or whether procurement policies were violated; no legal conclusions can be drawn from the records alone."]}
